text: Split with PEO-050, so the two briefs do not overlap: PEO-053 owns generation (line records per compartment, per-compartment seeds, independent picks, fill until full with packed_dims from PEO-052, counts drawn in proportion to the rolled room area as PEO-054's fit rule assumes, aftermath sampled from the address, freeze on search). PEO-050 owns what happens after (read-through the seed, instantiate on take or change, D-026 put-back as its own entry, the unexamined mark, D-029 quality sampling, the hidden cap). Brief both once PEO-008 is briefed; they share its baked variant table.

D-030 (N018): generation order per compartment is purpose, then main loot, then extras for the kind, ctx and detail tags, all from the compartment seed with the salts in PEO-057's brief; port tools/content/generate.py and pin C++ against its roll cases. The purpose name is stored on the compartment and shown once examined; D-026's unexamined mark applies to the compartment's name as well as its lines. Nested containers inherit ctx.
